info.title: cascade 0.1.0 — Cascade UI CLI tool
info.description: Cascade UI CLI tool — cascade watch, cascade doctor, cascade new

options.name: --sync
options.description: Create or update all agent instruction files

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Files managed by --sync:
CLAUDE.md                        Claude Code, Copilot CLI
AGENTS.md                        OpenAI Codex agents
.github/copilot-instructions.md  GitHub Copilot Chat
.github/copilot/mcp.json         MCP server config (create only)
The --sync command uses markers to safely update files:
- New file: created with Cascade instructions
- Existing file with markers: Cascade section replaced
- Existing file without markers: Cascade section appended
- mcp.json: never overwritten if it already exists

options.name: --help
options.description:

Builds with 'dotnet publish -c Release' and reports binary size.
NativeAOT is enabled by default for optimal startup and size.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Checks performed:
• Fonts declared in csproj exist at declared paths
• String files — en.json is the reference locale
• All S.* references resolve to declared keys
• Icon packs declared in csproj are present
• [AiCapability] descriptions meet minimum length
• Declared assets exist at declared paths
These are the same checks that run during 'dotnet build'.

commands.name: focus
commands.description:
Move keyboard focus to a node
drag <node_id> [--delta-x <value>] [--delta-y <value>] [--start-x <value>] [--start-y <value>] [--end-x <value>] [--end-y <value>] [--steps <value>] [--wait-frames <value>] Simulate drag on a node
scroll [--delta-y <value>] [--delta-x <value>] [--x <value>] [--y <value>] [--coord-space <value>] [--to <value>] [--wait-frames <value>] Scroll viewport

commands.name: inspect
commands.description:
Full details for a node
find <query> [--by <value>] [--disabled] [--focused] [--visible] [--source-file <value>] Search nodes (case-insensitive)
diagnostics [--window-frames <value>] [--include-recent] Per-frame allocation, timing, and native counters
screenshot [-o <value>] [--output <value>] [--region <value>] [--region-space <value>] [--scale <value>] [--after-frame <value>] Capture screenshot to file
diff <action> [--name <value>] [--tolerance <value>] Screenshot baseline diff (capture_baseline/compare/list/clear)

commands.name: instances
commands.description:
Glyph quads overlapping a screen rect, with owning nodes
atlas [-o <value>] [--output <value>] [--region <value>] Save a glyph-atlas region as PNG
click <node_id> [--x <value>] [--y <value>] [--coord-space <value>] [--wait-frames <value>] Simulate click on a node (use --x/--y to click inside overlay popups)
hover <node_id> [--x <value>] [--y <value>] [--coord-space <value>] [--wait-frames <value>] Hover the pointer over a node (use --x/--y for a point; drives tooltips/hover states)

options.name: --rect
options.description: Only glyphs overlapping this device-pixel rect

options.name: --limit
options.description:
Max instances returned (default 200)
Each instance reports its atlas texel rect — pass it to
'cascade mcp atlas --region u,v,w,h' to see the actual bitmap.

options.name: --wait-frames

wait_frames (Int)
Types text into the focused element. Multiple words are joined

commands.name: whodrew
commands.description: List every draw touching a pixel, with owning node

arguments.name: Y
arguments.description:
(Double)
Lists every draw from the last presented frame touching the pixel,
in paint order (shapes, then images, then glyphs), each with the
DevTools node id that emitted it. Coordinates are device pixels —
the same space screenshots use. The first call enables draw capture
and repaints once.

commands.name: new

options.name: --installer
options.description:
Build a one-file installer from the app's [Installer] class
(NativeAOT by default: smaller, native, no JIT)

options.name: --no-aot
options.description: With --installer: self-contained JIT build (no C++ toolchain needed)

options.name: --keep-locales
options.description:
With --installer: keep ICU per-culture locale satellites
Installer signing (Authenticode; signs the wizard, uninstaller, and launcher):

options.name: --self-sign
options.description:
Generate a throwaway code-signing cert on the fly.
Nothing to install/manage — just give a name, e.g.
cascade package --installer --self-sign "Adam Marciniec"

options.name: --sign-cert
options.description:
Use an existing cert: a 40-char cert-store SHA-1 thumbprint,
or a path to a .pfx file (add --sign-password if it has one).

options.name: --sign-timestamp
options.description:
RFC-3161 timestamp server (default: DigiCert).
Requires signtool.exe (Windows SDK; auto-located). NOTE: a self-signed cert does
NOT stop end-user SmartScreen/AV warnings — only a real OV/EV cert builds reputation.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Size presets:
compact    500x800
medium     768x1024
expanded   1024x768   (default)
large      1440x900
Hot reload:
Changes to .cs files trigger Roslyn incremental compilation.
Method body edits are applied via Edit-and-Continue deltas
in < 700ms without losing component state.
Structural changes (new fields, type changes) trigger a full rebuild,
which kills the running app process, rebuilds, relaunches, and
re-acquires the hot-reload pipe automatically.
Performance target: < 700ms from save to visual update.
